# Construction risk assessment with machine learning

Curated by Skill Harbor — @datadrivenconstruction's risk-assessment-ml skill, listed here with credit to its creator (part of the DDC Skills for AI Agents in Construction series): a guide to assessing construction project risk with machine learning. It covers cost-overrun prediction, schedule-risk analysis, safety-incident prediction, and risk scoring from construction data sources (project histories, schedules, budgets, safety logs) — with feature engineering for construction data, model selection guidance, and risk-communication patterns for project stakeholders. Honest caveats: it is a decision-support tool, not a substitute for professional risk judgment — construction risk decisions stay with qualified engineers and project managers, and the skill's predictions are only as good as your historical project data; your data comes from you (project management systems, BIM, ERP); no model predicts force majeure. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
